contacts.list.description: Use the code-owned official gmail API contract for contacts.list. Select saved contacts, Other contacts, or a metadata-only Gmail interaction projection with explicit completeness and send-as alias exclusion

collection.description: Google contact projection; defaults to saved contacts

after.description: Optional inclusive whole-second UTC lower bound for incremental interactions

before.description: Fixed whole-second UTC cutoff required only for the interactions projection

cursor.description: Opaque Google People or Gmail API next-page token

include_stats.description: Compute bounded sent and received Gmail statistics; defaults to true

limit.description: Bounded page count; defaults to 20 for contacts and 100 for interactions

stats_scan_limit.description: Maximum messages scanned per contact and direction when include_stats is true; defaults to 100; limit multiplied by this value cannot exceed 2000

messaging.list.description: Use the code-owned official gmail API contract for messaging.list. subject-bound GET Gmail /gmail/v1/users/me/threads with fixed INBOX selection or one bounded query, followed by bounded metadata reads; no modify, acknowledgement, or read-receipt request

view.description: List the inbox or execute one explicit Gmail search

query.description: Exact Gmail search expression; required only for search

include_spam_trash.description: Include matching spam and trash threads for search

messaging.read.description: Use the code-owned official gmail API contract for messaging.read. subject-bound GET Gmail /gmail/v1/users/me/threads/{thread} with exact response identity and bounded MIME projection; no modify, acknowledgement, or read-receipt request
